messages:
Rae (AM): NovaCare RFI landed. they want a 3-week eval, EU data residency, and answers to a 90-question security questionnaire. file: <https://drive.redwood.com/attachments/novacare_rfi.xlsx|novacare_rfi.xlsx>
Omar (SE): Scope: chat assist + embeddings + rerank. they asked for model explainability notes and a capability matrix comparing hosted vs private.
Ben (Pricing): Ballpark for 3-week POC: $7k pro-rated dedicated pool + usage. add 24/7 support = $1k/week. need tokens/day estimate.
Rae (AM): They estimate 1.5M tokens/day avg, peak 4M. Also asked about SLA: 99.9% uptime and median <250ms.
Quinn (Eng): 250ms median for 13b quant in EU is borderline. recommend offering 250ms median with fallback to 7b for stricter latency. I'll draft infra snippet.
Lina (Security): Questionnaire flags: data residency, KMS/HSM, log retention, breach notice. Also asked about GDPR DPA and subprocessors list. I'll start drafting answers.
Omar (SE): Proposed models: redwood-llama-13b-quant primary, redwood-llama-7b fallback. Embeddings: batch 128, cache common prefixes.
Quinn (Eng): Deploy manifest sample:
```
pool: dedicated-eu-std
instances: 2
model: redwood-llama-13b-quant
autoscale:
  min:1
  target_rps:80
```
Enable KV cache.
Ben (Pricing): I'll prepare a pro-rated spreadsheet and include an optional private deployment delta ($110k one-time).
Rae (AM): Action items: Omar update capability matrix (ETA 3h). Lina draft security answers (ETA EOD). Ben send pricing sheet (ETA 2h). Quinn propose perf test plan (ETA 5h). Contracts team will review DPA after we compile.
contracts-bot: Uploaded novacare_rfi.xlsx (size: 370KB)
Lina (Security): Quick Q: will they process PHI? that affects recommendation for Private. Rae, pls confirm with customer.
Rae (AM): I'll ask and update thread. scheduling internal sync at 2pm PST to assemble response.
Omar (SE): I'll also add a short 'how to reproduce' eval for their product team to run locally.
Ben (Pricing): ack.
Quinn (Eng): ack.
Lina (Security): ack.
